reviews.author: Miguel Webster

reviews.title: Oculus ready depends…
reviews.comment: The overall quality of the headset is great! But I ordered it to be a headset to use with my oculus. The short cord is great, but with my headset, the headphones don’t cover my ears. They hang loosely on the headset and the quality that way is terrible. Even the built in audio is Better than the headphones hanging over the edge. Make sure you have clearance if you plan on using these with your  Vr headset
